items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: The Alan Parsons project I had no idea that I played on the record until I read it in Musician Magazine 25 years later. It was a session at Abbey Road...

ctx.x: Yeah, and then after you’re done it feels weird because a person comes out —

Yeah. It’s a kind of reality check. But I mean this really goes along with the ambition to be a studio musician was just it doesn’t matter who you’re playing with it’s making music. I mean it looks good on the resume to have — that record with Rosemary Clooney was really cool. And I was 24, 25 at the time. It was mid-70s in London and she was making a comeback and she was on tour with Bing Crosby. It was not long before he died. And it was just a very cool experience, you know, playing with somebody of that kind…
And they called you at Apple.
